description: This Java class implements an auto-closing SLF4J logger that discards diagnostic context after each log operation.

classes.name: AutoClosingSlf4jLogger
classes.description: A thread-unsafe final class that wraps another AutoCloseableSlf4jLogger to automatically discard diagnostic data after each log.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of AutoClosingSlf4jLogger, ensuring the argument is not null.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets a correlation ID for the logger, returning the same instance for chaining.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds an MDC entry with a key and optional value, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the logger, collapsing resources or cleanup.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the underlying logger.

methods.name: isTraceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if TRACE level logging is enabled.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Logs a TRACE message with various argument overloads, each wrapping the call in a try-with-resources block to discard context after execution.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if DEBUG level logging is enabled.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a DEBUG message with various argument overloads, each wrapped to ensure context is discarded after logging.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if INFO level logging is enabled.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs an INFO message with various argument overloads, each wrapped in try-with-resources.

methods.name: isWarnEnabled
methods.description: Checks if WARN level logging is enabled.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a WARN message with various argument overloads, each wrapped similarly.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if ERROR level logging is enabled.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs an ERROR message with various argument overloads, each wrapped in try-with-resources.
